name: soulstone-play
description: A voice-first Minecraft teammate for family play
author: SovereignSignal

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:resources -- --target=win32 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Talk to your Minecraft teammate when you press Talk.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turn your spoken Minecraft requests into text.
